npc.runecraftory.bathhouse_attendant.1.d: Oh... you really feel that way about me? That's such a lovely thing to hear. I've always enjoyed having you around, %player%. You've become rather special to me, too. I'd be very happy to be with you.
My goodness, you've caught me by surprise! I suppose I've grown rather fond of our time together. You make me feel appreciated in a way I hadn't expected. Yes, I'd love to give this a chance.
Oh, dear... you're making me blush! I care about you very much, and I'd love to spend even more time together. Yes, I'd be happy to be with you!
Oh, that's very sweet of you, %player%. I'm truly touched, but I'm afraid I don't feel quite the same way. I hope we can still share a warm friendship.
You're very dear to me, but I don't think my feelings are romantic. Please don't think you've done anything wrong.
Oh my... I wasn't expecting that. I'm flattered, truly, but I think we're better suited as friends. I hope you understand.
Oh, for me? That's very thoughtful of you! Thank you, dear. It's always lovely to receive a little kindness.

Oh, thank you, dear. 
It's not quite my preference, but it was very kind of you to think of me.
Oh... I understand, %player%. I won't pretend this doesn't hurt, but I would never want you to remain in a relationship that no longer makes you happy. Please take good care of yourself.
So this is where our paths separate... I'm sorry things turned out this way. I'll always be grateful for the kindness and memories we shared.
I see, dear. I wish things could have been different, but I respect your decision. I sincerely hope you find the happiness and peace you deserve.
Oh, dear... are you sure? I don't believe we've ever been married. Perhaps you've gotten a little confused?
A divorce? But we aren't married, %player%. Let's not worry ourselves over things that haven't happened!
Oh my! That's quite a serious matter to bring up. Though I'm afraid there's no marriage between us to end in the first place.
npc.runecraftory.bathhouse_attendant.1.f:
Oh, hello there! Welcome, welcome. 
I'm %npc%, and I look after the bathhouse here. 
If you've had a long journey or simply need a moment of peace, you're always welcome. Everyone deserves a little time to relax.

Greetings! It's lovely to meet you. 
I'm %npc%, the owner of the local bathhouse. 
I take care of the place and make sure everyone feels comfortable. Do stop by sometime, especially after a tiring day!

Ah, a visitor! Welcome. I'm %npc%. 
I run the bathhouse nearby, a place where people can leave their worries at the door for a little while. There's nothing quite like a warm bath after a long day, wouldn't you agree?

Oh, hello! 
I'm %npc%, the one responsible for keeping the bathhouse warm and welcoming. 
It's a simple business, perhaps, but seeing people leave feeling a little happier makes all the work worthwhile.
Oh, that's quite alright. I have a few things to take care of here anyway. Please be careful out there!
I'm afraid I should stay behind today. There are people who might need the bathhouse, after all.
Perhaps another time, dear. I hope you have a pleasant and safe journey!
Already heading back? Very well. Thank you for letting me accompany you. I hope you had a pleasant time!
It was lovely spending some time with you, %player%. Now, don't forget to get some proper rest.
I'll return to the bathhouse, then. Take good care of yourself, and remember that you're always welcome there.
I hope you're not pushing yourself too hard, %player%. Even during a journey, it's important to take a moment to breathe.
It's nice to spend some time outside. Though I must admit, I do miss the warmth of the bathhouse already.
Please let me know if you need a break. There's no reason to exhaust yourself unnecessarily.
Oh, you'd like me to come along? Of course, dear. I'd be happy to accompany you. Just promise me you'll be careful.
Well, a little journey might be nice. I don't get out very often, so thank you for inviting me!
Certainly, %player%. I'd be glad to help however I can. Just make sure we take a little time to rest along the way.
npc.runecraftory.bathhouse_attendant.1.g:
Oh, %player%! How lovely to see you. 
I hope you've been taking good care of yourself. You shouldn't forget to rest every now and then.

Hello, dear! How has your day been? 
I hope it's been a pleasant one. 
And if it hasn't, perhaps you could use a little time to unwind.

Ah, there you are! It's always nice to see a familiar face. 
Have you been getting enough rest lately?

Good to see you again, %player%. 
You look like you've been keeping busy. 
Remember, there's no shame in slowing down sometimes.
npc.runecraftory.bathhouse_attendant.1.h:
Oh... I'm afraid this isn't something I particularly care for. 

I guess I will take it for now...
npc.runecraftory.bathhouse_attendant.1.l:
Oh, how lovely! What a thoughtful gift, %player%. 
Thank you so much, you've really brightened my day!
npc.runecraftory.bathhouse_attendant.1.m: Marriage...? Oh, %player%... that's such a beautiful thing to ask. I would love nothing more than to build a peaceful, happy life with you. Yes, of course I'll marry you!
Oh, my dear... you've made me so happy. I've spent so much of my life trying to make others feel at home, and now you've given me a home of my own. I accept!
Yes! A thousand times yes. I promise to always care for you, to listen when you need someone, and to make sure there's always a warm and welcoming place for you by my side.
Oh, that's a wonderful thought, dear. But marriage is such an important promise, and I don't think I'm quite ready to make it just yet. Please give me a little more time.
You've touched my heart, %player%. I care for you deeply, but I want to be certain that I'm ready for such a big step. I hope you can understand.
Oh, my... I'm truly touched. But I think we should enjoy what we have for a little longer before making such a lifelong commitment.
npc.runecraftory.bathhouse_attendant.1.p: Let's not rush, dear. We have all the time in the world, and I'd much rather we enjoy each other's company without worrying about anything.
Perhaps we should simply spend a quiet evening together for now. A little rest and affection can be wonderful, too.
Oh, not just yet, love. Even the happiest moments deserve a little breathing room. Let's take our time.
npc.runecraftory.bathhouse_attendant.1.t: I think people often underestimate the importance of simply resting. Everyone is so busy chasing after one thing or another that they forget to look after themselves. A little peace and quiet can make all the difference.
I always try to make the bathhouse welcoming to everyone. It doesn't matter whether someone is rich or poor, a traveler or a villager. Everyone deserves to feel comfortable and cared for.

Sometimes visitors come here carrying more than just physical exhaustion. You can often tell when someone has had a difficult time. I always try to give them a little extra kindness, even if it's just a warm smile.

Running a bathhouse takes more work than people might imagine. There's always something to clean, repair, or prepare. But I don't mind. Knowing that people have a place to relax makes every bit of effort worthwhile.
